speaker_name: Address by Mr. Nayib Armando Bukele
speaker_title: Address by Mr. Nayib Armando Bukele, President of the Republic of El Salvador

paragraphs.text: Humankind has endured very challenging times. And it was in these moments that it has had the opportunity to truly evaluate the path that it should take. They are the breaking points where we, as humankind, decided on the path we would take.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Humankind has endured very challenging times. And it was in these moments 
that it has had the opportunity to truly evaluate the path that it should take. They are 
the breaking points where we, as humankind, decided on the path we would take.

paragraphs.text: Sometimes crises are warnings to change our path, to reflect on whether or not what we are doing is truly what we want to do, and to think about the kind of future in which we want to live.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Sometimes crises are warnings to change our path, to reflect on whether or not 
what we are doing is truly what we want to do, and to think about the kind of future 
in which we want to live.

paragraphs.text: So it was after the First World War, when, among other things, the predecessor of the United Nations, the League of Nations, was created, and humankind began a period of strong social, cultural, economic and artistic dynamism.
paragraphs.raw_text:
So it was after the First World War, when, among other things, the predecessor 
of the United Nations, the League of Nations, was created, and humankind began a 
period of strong social, cultural, economic and artistic dynamism.

paragraphs.text: The “Roaring 20s” — a decade in which humankind reflected on the future it wanted and worked to achieve it.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The “Roaring 20s” — a decade in which humankind reflected on the future it 
wanted and worked to achieve it.

paragraphs.text: It was born out of a crisis, and fate wanted it to be stopped by another one — the Great Depression. A decade of economic crisis and pessimism. A warning that humankind did not heed, which led to an even greater crisis — the Second World War.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It was born out of a crisis, and fate wanted it to be stopped by another one — 
the Great Depression. A decade of economic crisis and pessimism. A warning that 
humankind did not heed, which led to an even greater crisis — the Second World War.

paragraphs.text: This time, the blow was enough to learn from and make a decision on the path humankind should follow. It led to the founding of the United Nations, whose aim was to maintain international peace, achieve global security and spur economic and social development.
paragraphs.raw_text:
This time, the blow was enough to learn from and make a decision on the path 
humankind should follow. It led to the founding of the United Nations, whose aim 
was to maintain international peace, achieve global security and spur economic and 
social development.

paragraphs.text: A new momentum was created; a new era of optimism for the future, during which we collectively forged that vision, that image we wanted, and each one of us did our part to achieve it.
paragraphs.raw_text:
A new momentum was created; a new era of optimism for the future, during 
which we collectively forged that vision, that image we wanted, and each one of us 
did our part to achieve it.

paragraphs.text: It is era I still relive a bit. I recall us thinking about the future and being excited about it, enjoying our moment and, therefore, helping to create it.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is era I still relive a bit. I recall us thinking about the future and being 
excited about it, enjoying our moment and, therefore, helping to create it.

paragraphs.text: So long as we are alive, we must cultivate these moments of optimism. We must maintain them and move them forward as much as we can.
paragraphs.raw_text:
So long as we are alive, we must cultivate these moments of optimism. We 
must maintain them and move them forward as much as we can.

paragraphs.text: Two years ago, I was at the General Assembly, as the newly elected President of a small country in Central America, El Salvador. That same General Assembly, which, several years ago, had generated such optimism, was on its way to becoming obsolete.

paragraphs.text: I proved it with a selfie to demonstrate that the world had changed; that it continues to change and that it is our duty to understand it and then harness our potential to take care of it and resolve the issues we can resolve.

paragraphs.text: We are in a world that is increasingly accelerated, fragmented, anxious, pessimistic and individualistic. It is a world where almost no one knows where we are headed or, at least, where we would like to go, solving problems just for the time being, jumping from crisis to crisis, until we reach one we cannot resolve.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We are in a world that is increasingly accelerated, fragmented, anxious, 
pessimistic and individualistic. It is a world where almost no one knows where we 
are headed or, at least, where we would like to go, solving problems just for the time 
being, jumping from crisis to crisis, until we reach one we cannot resolve.

paragraphs.text: Society and the world are suffering, and we appear to be increasingly further away from addressing the causes of this suffering.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Society and the world are suffering, and we appear to be increasingly further 
away from addressing the causes of this suffering.

paragraphs.text: It is a world that continues to produce more than it needs; yet, there are people who continue to die of hunger and the lack of medicine and drinking water.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is a world that continues to produce more than it needs; yet, there are people 
who continue to die of hunger and the lack of medicine and drinking water.

paragraphs.text: It is a world where if people want to do something different, they are attacked instead of being guided and assisted in forging their own path — a path the rest of humankind could follow.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is a world where if people want to do something different, they are attacked 
instead of being guided and assisted in forging their own path — a path the rest of 
humankind could follow.

paragraphs.text: It is a world, still amid a pandemic, where we have seen the worst and the best of our species and whose collective response has only increased anxiety across the world. The pandemic has deepened the crisis that already existed, while bringing us closer than we have been in decades to the collapse of our civilization.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is a world, still amid a pandemic, where we have seen the worst and the best 
of our species and whose collective response has only increased anxiety across the 
world. The pandemic has deepened the crisis that already existed, while bringing us

paragraphs.text: It is a world with crises of all kinds, but primarily one with an identity crisis, and extremely anxious about the path it is taking.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is a world with crises of all kinds, but primarily one with an identity crisis, 
and extremely anxious about the path it is taking.

paragraphs.text: Civilization is fragile; so, too, is the advancement of humankind. And we are failing to advance. One more crisis and we could lose much more, and much faster, than we believe possible.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Civilization is fragile; so, too, is the advancement of humankind. And we are 
failing to advance. One more crisis and we could lose much more, and much faster, 
than we believe possible.

paragraphs.text: Let us learn from previous civilizations, from their achievements and their mistakes.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Let us learn from previous civilizations, from their achievements and 
their mistakes.

paragraphs.text: We have a responsibility to history, to all those who came before us, to continue humankind’s progress and advance as far as we can, to build on what they built; to build on the shoulders of giants.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We have a responsibility to history, to all those who came before us, to continue 
humankind’s progress and advance as far as we can, to build on what they built; to 
build on the shoulders of giants.

paragraphs.text: On a path that leads to the future, but that respects and values where we come from. Our traditions, our customs, our culture — the things that make us a civilization. But always moving forward and, at the same time, preparing those who will follow us in this relay race that is global development.
paragraphs.raw_text:
On a path that leads to the future, but that respects and values where we 
come from. Our traditions, our customs, our culture — the things that make us a 
civilization. But always moving forward and, at the same time, preparing those who 
will follow us in this relay race that is global development.

paragraphs.text: We still have time to learn from this crisis and to analyse whether or not we are doing what we should be doing and on the path on which we want to be.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We still have time to learn from this crisis and to analyse whether or not we are 
doing what we should be doing and on the path on which we want to be.

paragraphs.text: We have all the tools to do so. We live in an interconnected, globalized world with the technology to easily solve all these problems, but without the minimum will to do so.
